name: AutoComplete
usage: Email addresses and domains, tags, search with suggestions

props.name: options
props.description: The suggestions, usually filtered in `onSearch`.

props.name: value
props.description: Current text (controlled).

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial text (uncontrolled).

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new text, when typing or choosing a suggestion.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called with the typed text, to update the suggestions.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a suggestion is chosen.

props.name: filterOption
props.description:
Filters the suggestions by the typed text: `true` keeps those that contain it (ignoring case), or a function.
Leave it out when `onSearch` already filters them.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Text shown while the field is empty.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Shows a clear button while the field has text.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the field.

props.name: block
props.description: Fills the width of the container.

props.name: size
props.description: Size: `sm` in table rows and toolbars, `lg` for prominent forms. Without it, the size follows the density.

props.name: variant
props.description:
Appearance: `filled` (a borderless well in the surface, the default), `outlined` (surface background with a thin
border) or `borderless`.

props.name: status
props.description: Validation status, usually set by Form.Item.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the input element, so that a `<label for>` can point to it (Form.Item sets it).

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name, when there is no visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the input.

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Id of the element that describes the input, such as a hint.

props.name: testId
props.description:
Test id, rendered as `data-testid`: on the root element of Select, TreeSelect, Cascader and AutoComplete, on the
input of DatePicker and TimePicker, and on an element that adds no box around the two inputs of a range picker.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the input when it mounts.

props.name: onFocus
props.description: Called when the input gets the focus.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called when the input loses the focus.

props.name: onKeyDown
props.description: Called on key presses in the input.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Text filled into the field when the suggestion is chosen.

fields.name: label
fields.description: Content shown in the list; `value` by default.

examples.name: Basic
examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: Suggests complete email addresses while typing; any text can still be entered.
